changeinfo.changes:
• Turning off music player in the apartment no longer turns off music for stages
  • Enemies in “Lux in Tenebris” are no longer alerted by flashing lights
  • Heads-on-chains can now be killed with throwing weapons
  • Throwing knives now stick into monsters
  • Throwing items on the dock no longer get stuck in mid-air
  • Fridge door sprite no longer missing

• Fixed rare, random teleporting, most often occurring in Enter the Hounds
  • Fixed War trophy. If you already have five stars in all levels in your save slot but don't have the trophy, just replay any level in that save slot again at five stars to unlock War
  • A particular light switch in the Vall level (part 2) would crash the game if it was turned off. Bad light switch! It has been disciplined
  • Burst Rifle now lives up to its name and fires in bursts
